_meta.description: Lead rotation (change pipeline-lead-rotation, task 1.1). An agent profile gets a 30-day lead cap and a pause switch; a lead records why rotation gave it to its owner. No property changes type and none becomes required.

leadCapPer30Days.title: Lead cap per 30 days
leadCapPer30Days.description: The most new leads rotation gives this colleague in 30 days. Empty means no cap.

pauseLeadAssignment.title: Pause lead assignment
pauseLeadAssignment.description: While on, rotation gives this colleague no new leads, for example during leave.

assignmentReason.title: Why this owner
assignmentReason.description: Why rotation gave the lead to its owner, or why nobody was eligible.
